# ModDeck 贡献与协作指南 / Contributing Guidelines

[English below]

感谢您对 ModDeck 项目的关注！

## 🇨🇳 中文说明

为了确保本项目的代码安全与架构纯粹，并考虑到作者有限的个人业余维护精力，本项目采取 **「开放开源，但策略保守（Issues-Only）」** 的维护模式：

1. **欢迎提交 Issues**：
   - 欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/yuzhoujun/ModDeck/issues) 提交使用疑难、Bug 报告、体验优化建议或角色译名词库纠错；
   - 提交 Bug 时请尽量提供复现步骤、游戏名称、操作系统版本以及必要的日志（如 `%APPDATA%\ModDeck\logs\startup.log`）。

2. **暂不接受外部代码 Pull Request (PR)**：
   - 为防范供应链注入风险（恶意/来路不明代码）并降低代码审核负担，**本项目目前不接收任何外部代码 PR**；
   - 任何未沟通直接提交的代码 PR 将会被礼貌关闭，请勿花费精力提交流水线式或未经商讨的代码 PR。

3. **自由 Fork 与独立衍生**：
   - 本项目基于 MIT 协议完全开放源码，欢迎自由 Fork、学习和自行定制；
   - 任何第三方 Fork 与衍生分发版本均属于独立第三方行为，官方仓库不对任何第三方 Fork 的安全性、稳定性与合规性负责，亦不为其做任何背书。

---

## 🌐 English Guide

Thank you for your interest in ModDeck!

To protect software integrity and code security, and given limited individual maintenance bandwidth, ModDeck operates under an **"Open Source, Conservative Maintenance (Issues-Only)"** model:

1. **Issues are Welcome**:
   - Please feel free to open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/yuzhoujun/ModDeck/issues) for bug reports, questions, feature suggestions, or character dictionary updates.
   - When reporting a bug, please include reproduction steps, game title, OS version, and relevant logs (`%APPDATA%\ModDeck\logs\startup.log`).

2. **Closed Pull Request Policy**:
   - To guard against supply chain vulnerabilities and avoid unvetted third-party code injection, **we do not accept external code Pull Requests (PRs)**.
   - Unsolicited PRs will be politely closed. Please do not submit unsolicited code modifications.

3. **Forks & Independent Builds**:
   - The project is fully open source under the MIT License. You are free to fork, experiment, and maintain your own versions.
   - Any third-party forks or external binaries are solely the responsibility of their respective authors. The upstream project provides zero warranty or endorsement for downstream forks.
